name: Tomb Guardians

specialRules.name: Home Ground
specialRules.text: The Tomb Guardians live in the Necropolises and easily locate hidden tombs: a Tomb Guardian warband always rolls one extra die in the Exploration phase.

specialRules.name: Undead
specialRules.text: All Undead warriors cause fear, are immune to psychology (never leave combat), treat Stunned as Knocked Down (no pain), may not run (but may charge), are immune to poison, and never gain experience if they have no brain (Skeletons). Tomb Lords do not learn new skills but remember those they knew in life; Liche Priests and Acolytes retain a living mind and can learn from experience.

specialRules.name: Flammable
specialRules.text: The Tomb Lord takes double the normal number of wounds from a hit by a fire-based attack.

equipmentLists.name: Undead equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Tomb Lord, Skeleton Warriors, Tomb Guards

items.name: Asp Arrows
items.note: Tomb Lords only. Made from mummified remains of poisonous snakes, guided by ancient magic. +1 to hit.

items.name: Nehekharan Javelin
items.note: Tomb Lords only. Range 8", Strength as user, +1 to hit.

equipmentLists.name: Liche Priest equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Liche Priest, Acolytes (no missile weapons or armour)

items.name: Serpent staff
items.note: Liche Priests only. Two-handed, may be used to Parry. The Liche Priest may forgo all normal attacks and parries in a round to use the staff: the serpent always attacks first in close combat with a single attack at WS4 and S4.

equipmentLists.name: Skeleton Chariot
equipmentLists.usedBy: Warband (0-1); buyer not specified in the PDF

items.name: Skeleton Chariot
items.note: 200 + 10D6 gc. 0-1. Profiles (M WS BS S T W I A Ld): Chariot - - - 4 4 3 - - -; Skeleton Steed (x2) 8 2 2 3 3 1 2 1 5. Pulled by two Skeleton Steeds, driven by a charioteer (requires the Drive Chariot (academic) skill to charge). Moves 8", may not run, may double move when charging. Difficult ground: D3 Strength 4 hits (2D3 Strength 6 hits if charging). If one steed dies, half movement and charge but no impact hits; if both die the chariot is immobile and the charioteer fights on foot. Impact hits on a charge: each model in the path may take an Initiative test to dodge; otherwise one Strength 4 hit with -2 armour save. Enemies in contact may strike chariot or driver; shooting at a chariot gets +1 to hit, and a hit goes to steed on 1-4, chariot 5-8, charioteer 9-12 (D12).

fighters.name: Tomb Lord

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: The Tomb Lord is the warband's Leader and follows all the rules for Leaders (models within 6" may use his Leadership).

specialRules.name: Undead
specialRules.text: Follows all rules for the Undead (fear, immune to psychology, no pain, may not run, immune to poison).

specialRules.name: Flammable
specialRules.text: Takes double wounds from fire-based attacks.

specialRules.name: Do Not Drink
specialRules.text: Does not need food and water (living animals that accompany Mummies follow the water rules as normal).

fighters.notes: Printed profile row is labelled 'Mummy'. Called Mummy Prince in the starting experience section.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: A Wizard that uses Mortuary Cult scrolls (cast like normal spells, must test to read the incantation correctly).

specialRules.name: Undead
specialRules.text: Follows all rules for the Undead but has retained a living mind and can learn from experience.

specialRules.name: No armour
specialRules.text: May not wear armour as it interferes with spell casting.

conversionNotes: tombguardians.pdf and warband_pdfs/TownCryer18.pdf are byte-identical (same md5), so there are no differences. Rules are on PDF pages 6-12 (printed 4-10) plus scrolls on page 15.
Skeleton Chariot hit location D6: 1-2 steed, 3-4 chariot, 5-6 charioteer -> D12: 1-4, 5-8, 9-12.

Mortuary Cult Scroll spell difficulties and effects are not captured in this schema. Menkare's Scroll of Urgency (6), Horrebe's Curse of the Mummy (8), Tawosret's Tomb Dust (7), Neferre's Quaking Horror (7), Merneptah's Scarab Song (7), Djedre's Vengeful Dead (5); the spell table is rolled on a D6 (becomes D12 in d12heim).
Scorpion sting uses Black Lotus poison rules; the Scorpion S is printed '2*'.
Skeleton Chariot is 200+10D6 gc and is a 0-1 special item; the PDF does not state who buys it. Cost note given in item note.
Skills: Mummy (Tomb Lord) Combat/Shooting/Strength; Liche Priest Academic; Acolyte Combat/Academic. The skill table marks Mummy/Liche/Acolyte only.
Maximum characteristics table (Tomb Lord and Liche Priest/Acolyte) printed in the PDF was not transcribed.
Tomb Lord max 1 / min 1; warband must include one Tomb Lord.
